description: One delivery and its outcome. state is queued (carries held: true, holdKind, heldUntil and action while its account is paused or awaiting reconnect), provider_accepted (the network has it and is still processing), published (receipt.url is the live post), failed (error says why, kind classifies the cause and action names the next step), unknown (kind is maybe_published: check the profile before sending again) or cancelled.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.
